not_worker_fixable_reason: Both resolutions re-stamp a frozen cross-artifact token policy or move frozen schema bytes; a worker event cannot set a gate verdict or validation_status, and a canonical write by the wrong owner is a class/ownership violation.
falsifier: Show (a) a frozen adjudication declaring one of the two token forms the sole canonical conclusion_type and re-stamping the losing artifacts at a recorded hash, or (b) that F2a's accepts did not rely on the canonical token and the gate owner treats F0's allowed list as operative for F2b alone.
